heroHeadline: Day 684: Noroeste Revises Cumulative Death Toll to 3,353 Since Sep 2024 — 793 More Than Previously Counted; CJNG Checkpoint Near Culiacán Confirmed on Google Street View; Daily Targeted Killings Continue in Culiacán and El Rosario Despite Murciélagos Deployment
heroSubtitle: 684 days of cartel civil war — June 6–7, 2026: Noroeste's June 6 cumulative violence tracker updated to 3,353 homicides, 3,957 kidnappings, and 11,423 vehicle thefts since September 9, 2024 — attributed to the Guzmán-Zambada faction dispute, substantially higher than the previous Noroeste count of 2,560 and now consistent with the WSJ's May 17 estimate of 3,000+. Escuinapa municipality entered its 14th consecutive day of gunfire and explosions as of June 6. Daily violence continued in Culiacán: Valle Alto water purification business (1 dead, 1 injured, June 6 afternoon); Urbivilla del Roble food delivery driver killed (June 6 evening); Nueva Galicia foot-pursuit execution (June 7 at 5:30 AM); Army Ocelotl unit secured explosives cache in El Rosario after residents reported five blasts (June 6 evening, reported June 7). June 7: Infobae published Google Street View documentation of six CJNG gunmen at an armed checkpoint in Tepuche (northwest Culiacán), confirming the Los Chapitos–CJNG operational alliance at its peak — the checkpoint's operational commander El Jardinero was arrested April 27. FGR–Sheinbaum contradiction on Rocha Moya's Interpol Red Notice remains unresolved (since June 5). La Mayiza holds ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops under interim Governor Bonilla Valverde. El Chinacate at Altiplano with ~20 days remaining on US extradition deadline (~July 27). Summer calendar: El Mayo EDNY July 20, Ovidio NDIL July 27, Joaquín NDIL Aug 31.
